summary: Iteration 6 — backend-only regression after server.py refactor (extraction of formcheck/payments/push into routers/*). All 33 tests pass (14 from test_new_features_v5.py + 19 new tests in test_refactor_routers.py). Zero behavioral regression. Routes confirmed mounted exactly once via OpenAPI introspection (localhost:8001/openapi.json). All 11 refactored paths present with correct HTTP methods and no duplicate registrations. Backend logs clean — no double-registration warnings. server.py shrunk from 2502 → 2201 lines (verified). Refactor scope confirmed correct: routers import shared symbols (db, models, helpers, VAPID_PUBLIC_KEY, _send_web_push, EMERGENT_LLM_KEY, get_current_user, require_premium, etc.) FROM server at the BOTTOM of server.py (deferred imports avoid circular-import). FormCheck (analyze/history/delete), Payments (checkout/status/webhook), Push (vapid-public-key/subscribe/settings GET+PUT/unsubscribe/test) all functional. Core endpoints (auth/me, plans/current, sessions/stats, coach/insights, admin/stats, bodyscan/history) all 200 for admin. Stripe webhook accepts POST without auth and returns {received: true} for unknown event types when STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET is unset (signature-bypass path via json.loads — note: in prod with secret set, an unsigned payload like this would 400, which is correct). Payments checkout invalid plan → 400 'Ungültiger Plan'. Payments status for fake session_id → 404 'Transaktion nicht gefunden'. Push subscribe→PUT update→GET verify→test→DELETE unsubscribe full lifecycle works (deleted_count=1).

minor.issue: Model still hardcoded as gpt-5.5 in routers/formcheck.py:78 (carried over from server.py). Other vision endpoints use gpt-5.2. Pre-existing inconsistency, not introduced by the refactor.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py is still 2201 lines after this refactor — well above the 700-line guideline. Recommended next extraction targets: /coach/* (insights/chat), /nutrition/*, /sessions/*, /bodyscan/* (analyze + plan-adjust + history), /profile/*, /admin/* (stats + activity). The pattern established here (router file imports from server at the bottom of server.py) works cleanly and avoids circular imports — same pattern can be reused.

Deferred-import pattern (`from routers import x` placed AFTER all top-level defs in server.py) is a workaround that future devs may not notice — add a 1-line comment at line 2179 explaining why it must stay at the bottom, to prevent someone moving it to the top and breaking everything.
FormCheck model 'gpt-5.5' inconsistency persists (was flagged in iter 5). Worth verifying intentional vs typo.

routers/payments.py + routers/formcheck.py + routers/push.py have NO unit tests of their own — they're only covered indirectly via HTTP integration tests. As the codebase modularizes, consider adding module-level imports tests (e.g. `from routers import formcheck` succeeds, `formcheck.router.routes` contains expected paths).
routers/__init__.py exists but is empty — fine. If the refactor continues, consider re-exporting routers from __init__ to centralize the wiring list.
/openapi.json is reachable internally (port 8001) but not externally through the ingress — this is by design (only /api/* is proxied) but worth documenting if external API explorers are needed.
